_doc: Tuning knobs for the unified improvement Routine (prompts/routine2.md). 'enabled_modes' controls which modes the selector may pick; 'weights' are the long-run share of runs (normalized). A mode with weight 0 never runs on rotation; 'floors' gives such a mode a temporary effective weight when its trigger fires (wiki: unharvested observations >= observations_unharvested_lines AND at least wiki_min_days_between_runs since the last wiki run). systemic-fix self-suppresses when planning/wiki/ideas/backlog-queue.json has no open batch-ready item; candidates self-suppresses while candidate_words.json holds >= candidate_restock_threshold words; accuracy-review self-suppresses when the OpenRouter daily cap is spent. Reweighted 2026-09-02 (enhancement/assessment-2026-09-02.md §6.A3): accuracy and systemic-fix up, new-entries down (internal closure only), wiki trigger-only.
